description:
Embed V4.0 embedding model

Embed V4.0 is served by Cohere over an OpenAI-compatible API. Requests are proxied through the UnitySVC gateway; you bring your own Cohere API key (the byok channel), so token usage is billed by Cohere directly and the service is free through UnitySVC.
name: embed-v4.0

payout_price.description: Service provider charges $0.12 / $0 per 1M input/output tokens
